tasks.label: Init SQLite DB
args: import sqlite3; conn = sqlite3.connect('words.base.db'); conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS words (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, word TEXT NOT NULL, translation TEXT NOT NULL, list_name TEXT NOT NULL)"); conn.commit(); print(conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='words'").fetchall()); print(conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(words)").fetchall()); conn.close()
